commentary_segments.text: This concludes the comparison between MOSTs and bipolar transistors. It is clear that a bipolar transistor is better for highprecision circuitry, but a MOST is more compatible with CMOS logic. A BiCMOS process seems to be the ideal compromise, but is more expensive unfortunately. Now that models for hand calculations have been derived, they will be used in elementary circuits.
